artistic_assessment.overall_category: stylized neutral realistic cartoon, not appropriate for artisan Hokkaido salmon-bearing woodcarving
strengths: Existing full body and four leg proportions
The GLB is genuinely downloadable, with a verified publisher CC0 dedication
Separate components can be inspected independently
blockers: Bear muzzle is elongated and toy-like; no convincing brow/eye anatomy
Four paws read as heavy padded circles with simplistic claws, especially in side view
Main high-poly torso mesh is open and broken into many visual parts; not a watertight single sculpt
No salmon, mouth cavity or physical bite topology
No sculpted Hokkaido fur directional chisel relief
artistic_assessment.next_step: Do NOT integrate as official full-body replacement. Locate a realistic CC BY or CC0 artist-authored bear mesh with a credible side/front face; legal download and actual Blender render required. Use source for blockout only.
